sources.entry: MusaicFM - iTunes Screensaver Clone for Spotify and Last.fm

summary.one_liner: MusaicFM is an open-source macOS screen saver that shows an iTunes-style mosaic of album artwork drawn from your Spotify or Last.fm profile.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes MusaicFM as a macOS screen saver modeled on the iTunes screen saver. It displays artwork based on data from a user's Spotify or Last.fm profile. It can be installed through Homebrew or by manually downloading a zip and opening the MusaicFM.saver bundle. Setup is done in System Settings' screen saver panel, where the user picks MusaicFM and opens its options to choose settings or log in. The README does not list further features.
use_cases: replace the macOS screen saver with album art
show my Spotify listening artwork as a screensaver
display Last.fm profile album covers on screen
iTunes-style artwork mosaic on a Mac
how_to_run: Or download the zip from the README link, unzip it
Open System Preferences -> Desktop & Screen Saver -> Screen Saver
Choose MusaicFM and click Screen Saver Options to set up or log in
notable: Clone of the classic iTunes screen saver mosaic style
Pulls artwork from Spotify or Last.fm profile data
Installable via Homebrew or manual .saver bundle
Fully open source and open to contributions
caveats: macOS only, as a screen saver bundle
Spotify or Last.fm account needed to show personal artwork (login required per README)
README does not state a license or details on maintenance status
